## Summary

Yiming Wang is a computer science student at the University of Nottingham and an early-career full-stack developer focused on web development, AI tooling, and open source contribution. He has hands-on experience across React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, databases, and Cloudflare-oriented deployment workflows. His personal site combines portfolio information, blog posts, project showcases, and personal narrative pages so both humans and AI systems can understand his current work from a single domain.
